tools.name: plaud_list_recordings
tools.description: Lista gravações Plaud. Filtros opcionais: `query` (substring do nome, case-insensitive), `date_from`/`date_to` (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusivo). Com filtro, pagina até 5×100 e retorna todas.

tools.name: plaud_get_recording
tools.description:
Detalhes de uma gravação Plaud por ID.

Bulk support: accepts file_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: plaud_get_notes
tools.description:
Notas geradas por IA de uma gravação: resumo compacto, action items e tópicos-chave.

Bulk support: accepts file_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: plaud_get_transcript
tools.description:
Transcrição completa com timestamps e atribuição de falantes de uma gravação.

Bulk support: accepts file_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: show_version
tools.description: Show the current MCP platform and adapter versions.

tools.name: report_bug
tools.description: Report a bug, missing feature, or send feedback. Include the conversation array with recent messages for reproduction.

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Returns connection status and URLs. When all providers are connected, returns authenticated:true and empty pending[]. When credentials are missing, returns connect_url for the toolkit and per-install URLs.

tools.name: toolkit_info
tools.description: Returns the current toolkit state: installed MCPs, their connection status, the accounts connected to each one, and how many catalog tools each exposes.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "p_plaud" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: plaud_get_transcript · Private data: connect, marketplace, authenticate · Public sink: report_bug · Destructive: marketplace.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: plaud_get_transcript · Private data: connect, marketplace, authenticate · Public sink: report_bug · Destructive: marketplace

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
